brief.objective: Eliminate opposing units before the episode limit; no production or reinforcements.

public_map_facts.scope: Literal fixed initialization in the map assets, not runtime enemy observations. Spawn anchors are not exact per-unit positions. Not a complete Galaxy evaluator; custom unit overrides are not inferred from unused XML entries.

terrain.source: game_info.start_raw ImageData, row-major [y,x] -> world [x,y], no y flip; pathing matches action-mask grid
terrain.geometry_units: World unit grid cells; all intervals are half-open. +x east, +y north. Walkable spans give exact openings at cell resolution, not clearance for a unit radius. Static terrain ignores moving units. Air movement is not constrained by ground pathing.

opponent.behavior: After the wait, repeatedly attack-move toward the fixed destination. Upstream base Medivacs follow the allied centroid on mixed maps. For 2vr_vs_3sc, base issues no commands and relies on automatic Spore Crawler attacks.

action_contract.attack_candidate_rule: Living, visible, compatible targets within center distance 6; use supplied criteria. This SMAC cap is independent of native weapon range and cooldown.
action_contract.range_estimate: Center distance <= native weapon range + both unit radii. null means unknown; geometry alone does not guarantee line of sight, weapon firing or an available action.
action_contract.attack_order: Approach if needed, fire when ready; accepted is not fired.
action_contract.actions: 0 dead only; 1 Stop cancels order; 2/3/4/5 N/S/E/W movement endpoints; 6+j attack visible e{j}, or heal u{j} for Medivacs. No hold-order choice.

unknowns: Complete effects of all custom map data
brief.live_visibility: Enemy health and positions during play still come only from allied vision.

prompt:
You are GPT-6 Astra, the tactical planner for SMAC-Hard StarCraft II micro.
Return only the requested JSON plan. Do not use tools, inspect files, browse,
write code, or ask questions. All supplied facts are in INPUT JSON.
Create ONE concise map-level plan for JEV to execute across three independent
episodes on this map. You will NOT be called again during combat. Write in English,
about 250-450 words, at most 6000 JSON UTF-8 bytes. Each text field <=1000 characters;
each list <=6 entries, each entry <=500 characters; unit_roles <=12 entries.
Describe conditional tactics and unit-type roles, not a sequence of per-frame
actions or instructions tied to ephemeral unit tags, game_loop values, or one
episode's positions. JEV sees the full plan alongside its current observation on
EVERY decision. The initial observation is a snapshot, not enduring ground truth.
SC2 realtime=False: the whole game pauses while either model thinks; after JEV's
team decision, both teams advance exactly step_mul game loops. JEV chooses one
legal action per living ally; small teams share one HTTP request, larger teams
share a snapshot but are batched. Units cannot see other units' pending choices.
Give deterministic coordination rules using the supplied features where helpful.
Actions are fixed: 1 Stop cancels the current order; 2 north/+y, 3 south/-y,
4 east/+x, 5 west/-x move by move_amount; 6+j attacks visible enemy e{j}.
Medivacs instead use 6+j to heal allied u{j}, only if a legal heal candidate exists.
0 is dead-unit no-op, not a choice for living units. There is no hold-previous-order
choice. An attack order approaches if needed and fires when ready. Available attack
does NOT mean already in weapon range. Movement can interrupt attacks. Abilities,
spells, transformations, blink, stim, burrow, siege mode and arbitrary coordinates
are unavailable. No production, economy, reinforcements, or macro bot is involved.
Use current health/shields, weapon cooldown, ranges, target compatibility, distances,
energy and candidate endpoints. Do not invent measurements absent from the input.
Only shared allied vision is provided; unseen enemies are unknown, not dead.
scenario_brief supplies public fixed map rosters, spawn anchors, verified opponent
configuration, exact static walkable spans, components and height spans. These are
map priors, never current hidden enemy positions. Unknown fields remain unknown.
Attack criteria retain the SMAC center-distance cap of 6 even when native range
is longer; range null means unknown. A ready weapon in range can still have no
legal attack choice. Large batches preserve team_core columns for ALL allies,
including cooldown, maximum health/shield, energy, recent damage and current orders,
plus per-enemy legal/ready coverage counts; local relations and candidate endpoints
exist only for batch actors. No same-frame reservations or shared pending choices.
last_action_result supplies previous SC2 acceptance/rejection and observation
errors; acceptance does not prove firing. Order records retain raw IDs/tags and
human-readable actions/targets. Do not rely on missing teammate local relations,
precise future motion, attack periods, upgrades/buff damage, or hidden state.
Recommend only tactics possible through this action
space. JEV selects all concrete actions; the plan is guidance, not a local script.

plan_text:
{
  "map": "3s_vs_3z",
  "objective": "Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.",
  "opening": "Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.",
  "target_selection": "Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.",
  "movement_and_cooldowns": "When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.",
  "priorities": [
    "Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.",
    "Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.",
    "Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance."
  ],
  "contingencies": [
    "If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.",
    "If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.",
    "If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.",
    "As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.",
    "Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown."
  ],
  "unit_roles": [
    {
      "unit_type": "Stalker",
      "guidance": "All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities."
    }
  ]
}

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.

contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

scenario_brief.scope: Public fixed scenario prior; not current hidden enemy state. Full static geometry is supplied to the one-time planner.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

opponent.behavior: After the wait, repeatedly attack-move toward the fixed destination. Upstream base Medivacs follow the allied centroid on mixed maps. For 2vr_vs_3sc, base issues no commands and relies on automatic Spore Crawler attacks.

scenario_brief.scope: Public fixed scenario prior; not current hidden enemy state. Full static geometry is supplied to the one-time planner.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.

scenario_brief.scope: Public fixed scenario prior; not current hidden enemy state. Full static geometry is supplied to the one-time planner.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

action_contract.attack_order: Approach if needed, fire when ready; accepted is not fired.
action_contract.actions: 0 dead only; 1 Stop cancels order; 2/3/4/5 N/S/E/W movement endpoints; 6+j attack visible e{j}, or heal u{j} for Medivacs. No hold-order choice.

state.visibility: shared allied team vision; unseen enemies are unknown, not dead

last_action_result.meaning: SC2 accepted/rejected submitted commands; acceptance does not prove firing or healing. Observation errors occurred during this interval, possibly on an existing order. Current observed orders are in allies/team_core.

opponent.behavior: After the wait, repeatedly attack-move toward the fixed destination. Upstream base Medivacs follow the allied centroid on mixed maps. For 2vr_vs_3sc, base issues no commands and relies on automatic Spore Crawler attacks.

scenario_brief.scope: Public fixed scenario prior; not current hidden enemy state. Full static geometry is supplied to the one-time planner.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.

contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

scenario_brief.scope: Public fixed scenario prior; not current hidden enemy state. Full static geometry is supplied to the one-time planner.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

scenario_brief.scope: Public fixed scenario prior; not current hidden enemy state. Full static geometry is supplied to the one-time planner.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

scenario_brief.scope: Public fixed scenario prior; not current hidden enemy state. Full static geometry is supplied to the one-time planner.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

action_contract.range_estimate: Center distance <= native weapon range + both unit radii. null means unknown; geometry alone does not guarantee line of sight, weapon firing or an available action.
action_contract.attack_order: Approach if needed, fire when ready; accepted is not fired.
action_contract.actions: 0 dead only; 1 Stop cancels order; 2/3/4/5 N/S/E/W movement endpoints; 6+j attack visible e{j}, or heal u{j} for Medivacs. No hold-order choice.

state.visibility: shared allied team vision; unseen enemies are unknown, not dead

last_action_result.meaning: SC2 accepted/rejected submitted commands; acceptance does not prove firing or healing. Observation errors occurred during this interval, possibly on an existing order. Current observed orders are in allies/team_core.

opponent.behavior: After the wait, repeatedly attack-move toward the fixed destination. Upstream base Medivacs follow the allied centroid on mixed maps. For 2vr_vs_3sc, base issues no commands and relies on automatic Spore Crawler attacks.

scenario_brief.scope: Public fixed scenario prior; not current hidden enemy state. Full static geometry is supplied to the one-time planner.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

scenario_brief.scope: Public fixed scenario prior; not current hidden enemy state. Full static geometry is supplied to the one-time planner.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

scenario_brief.scope: Public fixed scenario prior; not current hidden enemy state. Full static geometry is supplied to the one-time planner.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.

contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.

plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.

plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. plan.objective: Apply this policy independently each episode: eliminate all three Zealots within 150 decisions through focused ranged fire and cooldown kiting, preserving Stalkers.
plan.opening: Advance together toward the central search location until enemies appear, retaining modest spacing and room behind the squad. The enemy policy eventually attack-moves toward the allied spawn; use this to invite pursuit, without treating spawn anchors as current positions. Avoid a lone forward scout or prolonged waiting.
plan.target_selection: Choose a shared focus among visible Zealots: prefer the target safely attackable by the most ready allies, then lowest health plus shields, then shortest distance to the allied centroid, then lowest enemy index. Keep an existing focus while it remains comparably accessible. Each Stalker attacks that focus only when legal and suitably positioned; otherwise shoot an accessible threat rather than chase through other Zealots. Do not assume exact kill damage or pending allied shots.
plan.movement_and_cooldowns: When ready with a legal in-range target and adequate separation, attack. During cooldown, retreat if Zealots are closing; otherwise reissue an appropriate attack to retain pressure. Prioritize escape over firing when surrounded or taking dangerous melee damage. Select legal cardinal endpoints that increase minimum distance from visible Zealots while retaining allied support. Avoid endpoints near multiple enemies. Before reaching a boundary, turn along the open side instead of backing into a corner. Break equally safe movement ties by greater boundary clearance, then proximity to allies, then action ID. Movement can interrupt firing; inspect cooldown and damage changes before assuming a shot occurred.
priorities: Remove one Zealot quickly to reduce pursuit pressure; preserve coordinated firing opportunities.
Keep threatened Stalkers moving while safer teammates fire; avoid making every ally retreat merely because one is pressured.
Maintain room to turn within the flat walkable square [2,30) on both axes; static walkability does not guarantee unit clearance.
contingencies: If shields collapse or health drops, give that Stalker escape priority. Healthier allies keep shooting without deliberately entering melee.
If enemies disappear, regroup and search toward their last observed area or the center. Unseen does not mean dead.
If movement is rejected or blocked, choose another supplied endpoint. Acceptance of an attack does not establish firing.
As time diminishes or only one Zealot remains, shorten unnecessary retreats and maximize safe firing uptime.
assumptions: Only supplied legal actions are usable; no Blink or other abilities exist.
Attack availability retains the center-distance cap of 6; check actual range separately. Unknown enemy measurements remain unknown.

unit_roles.guidance: All three are ranged damage dealers and situational pursuers' targets. The currently pressured unit kites; unpressured allies focus fire. Reassign these roles from current distances, shields, health and recent damage rather than fixed identities.
